The cushion needle, which is now placed in the top for easier accessibility, can be adjusted using a simple hexagon wrench.

The cushion needle, which is now placed in the top for easier accessibility, can be adjusted using a simple hexagon wrench.

Up to 17% lighter than our existing rodless cylinder basic type, these lightweight cylinders can now be mounted with our dual colour Series D-M9*W solid state auto switch at any point along the mounting grooves. The cushion needle, which is now placed in the top for easier accessibility, can be adjusted using a simple hexagon wrench.
